label: authenticates via
type: which credential mechanism an access surface actually uses - e.g. capella:data-api authenticatesVia cluster-access-credential-type (Basic auth, same as statement pages); capella:management-api authenticatesVia mgmt-api:api-key (Bearer token)
note: Distinct from requiresPrivilege/requiresCapellaRole (which privilege/role is needed) - this is about the credential TRANSPORT mechanism itself, a question none of the statement-level relations addressed.
